text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor r-u-n-n-e-d t-e-s-t s-c-r-i-p-t-s to v-e-r-i-f-y the f-a-c-e s-c-a-n s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e and l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e t-h-a-t the p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e is o-n-f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-l-e-a-r-a-n-c-e to s-h-a-r-e the m-e-t-h-o-d-s
2) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d t-e-s-t a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s u-s-i-n-g the t-r-a-i-n-i-n-g p-e-r-s-o-n-n-e-l d-a-t-a and l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e t-h-a-t the a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s are m-a-r-k-e-d for d-e-m-o-l-i-t-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-l-e-a-n-u-p of the r-e-c-o-r-d-s
3) the actor d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e f-l-o-w in a c-l-o-s-e-d r-e-p-o-r-t and l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e t-h-a t the r-e-p-o-r-t is s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t o-n-l-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-v-i-e-w by s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y
4) the actor a-d-d-e-d a n-o-t-e a-b-o-u-t the l-o-g r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e in the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e l-o-g and l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e t-h-a-t the l-o-g-s are r-e-t-a-i-n-e-d for r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t by a-d-m-i-n-i-s-t-r-a-t-i-o-n
5) the actor c-l-o-s-e-d the m-a-t-t-e-r a-f-t-e-r the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e and l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e t-h-a t the m-a-t-t-e-r is f-i-l-e-d for i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-b-r-i-e-f
